variant_definitions.CONFIRM_3M: delay entry 180s; require positive net mark, breakout and VWAP held, and non-negative directional volume/large-trade flow
variant_definitions.COST_AWARE_BREAKEVEN: current MFE_V1 unchanged, plus a net-PnL zero floor after protection arms
variant_definitions.CONFIRM_3M_PLUS_COST_AWARE_BREAKEVEN: the fixed 180s confirmation plus the net-PnL zero floor

limitations: Only seventeen scorable independent signals across three historical sessions are available.
All three source sessions are partial and 20260923 contains callback errors.
Signals overlap and therefore are not one simultaneously executable 190k portfolio.
The 180-second rule is fixed from the stated hypothesis and was not parameter-optimized.
Rejected trades contribute zero PnL to opportunity expectancy; entry expectancy is also reported separately.
